Title: Scanner Operator signs in and lands on the Digitization shell
Preconditions: Scanner Operator provisioned with an operational centre; DVS_SCANNER_EMAIL and DVS_SCANNER_PASSWORD set in .env
Steps: 1) Open WEB_APP_URL; 2) Sign in with the Scanner's own email and password; 3) Wait for the authenticated shell to render
Expected Result: Post-login state resolves to shell and Primary navigation renders the Digitization module
Notes: tests/web/testcases/scanner-operator.spec.ts SCN-01 uses signInRole(page, scanner_operator); utils/dvsAuth.ts resolves shell | password-set | rejected

Title: Only Digitization is exposed in the primary navigation
Steps: 1) Sign in as the Scanner; 2) Inspect the Primary navigation button list
Expected Result: Digitization is the only module button; Access governance, Evaluation desk and Allocation engine each have count 0
Notes: spec SCN-02 asserts the visible Digitization button and the absence of the three foreign modules

Title: Operating centre shown matches the Scanner's assigned centre
Steps: 1) Open Digitization; 2) Read the Operating centre block; 3) Compare it with centre.id from GET /api/v1/receiving/guided/catalog
Expected Result: Operating centre text is visible and the catalog centre.id equals the provisioned centre id
Notes: spec SCN-03 proves the label; id equality is asserted in tests/api/workflow/dvs-role-workflow.spec.ts step 8.3

Title: auth/me reports the scanner_operator role
Steps: 1) Sign in with the Scanner credentials; 2) GET /api/v1/auth/me; 3) Read the role field
Expected Result: role = scanner_operator
Notes: spec SCN-04; schema api/schemas/auth_me_api_schema.json

Title: auth/me enables only the Digitization module for the role
Steps: 1) GET /api/v1/auth/me; 2) Read the enabled module list
Expected Result: Digitization is the only enabled module in the payload
Notes: Confirm the exact key that carries modules on the scanner payload (permissions vs enabled_modules) before asserting

Title: The session survives a reload of the Digitization workspace
Steps: 1) Open Digitization; 2) Reload the page; 3) Read the workspace
Expected Result: The workspace re-renders without a fresh sign-in and still shows the same Operating centre
Notes: Confirm the cookie session survives a reload on the tenant host; assert from storageState

Title: Sign out ends the session and returns to the sign-in screen
Steps: 1) Click Sign out in the shell banner; 2) Observe the landing screen; 3) Replay GET /api/v1/receiving/guided/catalog with the old context
Expected Result: Sign-in screen is shown and the protected read returns 401 or 403
Notes: AUTH_LOGOUT is documented in api/endpoints/routes.ts; the exact status after logout is unconfirmed

Title: Digitization exposes the Digitize scripts and Approved rescans tabs
Steps: 1) Open Digitization; 2) Read the tab list
Expected Result: Both tabs Digitize scripts and Approved rescans are present
Notes: No Digitization page object exists in pages/ yet, so this is a live-capture case

Title: The workflow stepper presents the five capture steps in order
Steps: 1) Open Digitize scripts; 2) Read the stepper labels left to right
Expected Result: Choose paper, Capture pages, Processing and storage, Submit to chief, Approved rescans appear in that order
Notes: Copy captured in the prompt; confirm it renders for the Scanner role rather than only for Admin

Title: Digitization is reachable and operable with the keyboard only
Steps: 1) Sign in; 2) Tab until Primary navigation holds focus; 3) Press Enter on Digitization; 4) Tab to the QP code control
Expected Result: Focus reaches the module and the QP code control, both activate without a pointer, and the focus ring stays visible
Notes: Follows playwright-mcp-context role-locator guidance; no keyboard assertion exists yet

Title: A wrong password is refused and no session is created
Steps: 1) Sign in with the Scanner email and an invalid password; 2) Read the response; 3) GET /api/v1/auth/me with that context
Expected Result: Login is rejected with 401 and auth/me returns 401
Notes: Mirror of tests/web/authentication/invalid-login.spec.ts applied to the Scanner account

Title: Repeated failed sign-ins are throttled per the tenant policy
Preconditions: failed_login_limit and lockout_minutes configured in Access governance
Steps: 1) Submit wrong passwords failed_login_limit times; 2) Attempt the correct password
Expected Result: The account is locked out for lockout_minutes and further attempts are rejected
Notes: Policy fields are captured in section 18; confirm they apply to scanner_operator

Title: Subject papers are limited to the assigned centre
Preconditions: Two centres, each with a submitted paper
Steps: 1) Sign in as the centre A Scanner; 2) GET /api/v1/receiving/guided/subject-papers; 3) Compare ids with the centre B papers
Expected Result: Only centre A papers are listed and no centre B paper id appears
Notes: md SCN-06; needs a second centre with a submitted paper

Title: Scanner cannot create a script for another centre's paper
Steps: 1) POST /api/v1/receiving/guided/subject-scripts with the centre B paper_id and a fresh idempotency_key; 2) Read the scripts of the centre B paper
Expected Result: Request is refused with 4xx and no script is created under centre B
Notes: md SCN-42; exact status and error message to confirm

Title: Scanner cannot read another centre's script list
Steps: 1) GET /api/v1/receiving/guided/subject-scripts?paper_id=<centre B paper>; 2) Count the groups and scripts returned
Expected Result: Response is 4xx or an empty group list and no centre B script is disclosed
Notes: Confirm whether the API returns 403 or an empty 200

Title: Scanner cannot request an upload intent for another centre's script
Preconditions: A centre B script id known
Steps: 1) POST /api/v1/repository/manual-scan/uploads with the foreign script_id, page_number 1 and content_type image/png; 2) Read the response status and body
Expected Result: Request is refused with 4xx and no upload intent is issued
Notes: Same guard expected as script creation; confirm the status code

Title: Scanner cannot submit another centre's subject group
Preconditions: A centre B group id known
Steps: 1) POST /api/v1/receiving/guided/subject-groups/{foreignGroupId}/submit; 2) Read the foreign group state afterwards
Expected Result: Refused with 4xx and the foreign packet stays open
Notes: Packet closure must not be writable across centres

Title: Scanner cannot finalize another centre's upload record
Preconditions: A centre B upload id known
Steps: 1) POST /api/v1/repository/uploads/{foreignUploadId}/finalize with a valid sha256 and byte_size; 2) Read the foreign upload status afterwards
Expected Result: Refused with 4xx and the foreign upload is not marked completed
Notes: Confirm 403 rather than an enumerable 404

Title: A client-supplied centre id cannot move script creation to another centre
Steps: 1) POST subject-scripts with the centre A paper_id plus operational_centre_id of centre B; 2) Read the created script
Expected Result: The script is created under centre A and the extra field is ignored
Notes: Server must derive scope from the session, never from the payload

Title: Unauthenticated read of the receiving catalog is refused
Steps: 1) GET /api/v1/receiving/guided/catalog without credentials; 2) Read the response status
Expected Result: 401 (or 403) is returned and no tenant data leaks
Notes: spec SCN-05 accepts 401 or 403

Title: Scanner cannot read the configuration catalog
Steps: 1) Sign in as the Scanner; 2) GET /api/v1/configuration/catalog
Expected Result: 403 is returned by /api/v1/configuration/catalog
Notes: spec SCN-07

Title: Scanner cannot read the Chief examiner summary
Steps: 1) Sign in as the Scanner; 2) GET /api/v1/chief/summary
Expected Result: 403 is returned by /api/v1/chief/summary and no chief data is disclosed
Notes: spec SCN-07

Title: Scanner cannot read the security catalog
Steps: 1) GET /api/v1/security/catalog; 2) Read the response status
Expected Result: 403 is returned by /api/v1/security/catalog and no membership data is disclosed
Notes: Route documented in api/endpoints/routes.ts; scanner denial not yet asserted

Title: Scanner cannot allocate a subject group
Steps: 1) POST /api/v1/allocation/examiner-batches/{batchId}/allocate-subject-group; 2) Read the response status
Expected Result: 403 is returned and no group is allocated
Notes: Chief-only action; confirms RBAC beyond read routes

Title: A state-changing call without the CSRF header is refused
Preconditions: Authenticated Scanner session holding a csrftoken cookie
Steps: 1) POST /api/v1/receiving/guided/subject-scripts without the X-CSRFToken header; 2) Read the script list
Expected Result: Request is refused with 403 and no script is created
Notes: utils/apiClient.ts sends X-CSRFToken plus Origin/Referer because the backend enforces it; status code to confirm

Title: A state-changing call from a foreign Origin is refused
Steps: 1) POST subject-scripts with Origin set to a different host; 2) Read the script list
Expected Result: Request is refused and no script is created
Notes: Same CSRF/double-submit protection path as SCN-025

Title: Extra body fields cannot widen the Scanner's scope
Steps: 1) POST subject-scripts with role=admin, permissions=* and enabled_modules including Exam configuration; 2) GET /api/v1/auth/me
Expected Result: auth/me still reports scanner_operator with only Digitization enabled
Notes: Privilege fields must be ignored on non-security routes

Title: The signed upload URL does not expose the stored page anonymously
Preconditions: A page has been uploaded and finalized
Steps: 1) GET the intent upload_url with no cookies and no intent headers; 2) GET it again with the intent headers after finalize
Expected Result: Both reads are refused with 4xx and the stored image is not publicly readable
Notes: Confirm the object stays private and only the finalize path links it

Title: Upload records cannot be probed across centres
Steps: 1) POST finalize for a random upload id with a plausible sha256 and byte_size; 2) Read the response status and body
Expected Result: Refused with 4xx and no foreign record details are returned
Notes: Only the finalize POST is documented; confirm there is no existence leak

Title: A replayed session cookie is refused after sign-out
Steps: 1) Capture the session cookie; 2) Sign out; 3) Replay GET /api/v1/receiving/guided/catalog with the captured cookie
Expected Result: 401 or 403 is returned
Notes: Confirms server-side session invalidation rather than client-only sign-out

Title: The receiving catalog is enabled for the centre
Preconditions: Centre active with at least one submitted paper
Steps: 1) GET /api/v1/receiving/guided/catalog; 2) Read enabled and centre
Expected Result: enabled = true and centre carries id, code and name
Notes: spec SCN-10; schema api/schemas/receiving_guided_catalog_api_schema.json

Title: A submitted paper is selectable with its settings
Steps: 1) GET /api/v1/receiving/guided/subject-papers; 2) Read the row of the run paper
Expected Result: The paper appears with id, code, title, scripts_per_packet and pages_per_script
Notes: spec SCN-11 and SCN-12; schema receiving_subject_papers

Title: The subject-script list returns groups for the paper
Preconditions: A script exists for the paper
Steps: 1) GET /api/v1/receiving/guided/subject-scripts?paper_id=<paper>; 2) Read groups[] and each group scripts[]
Expected Result: 200 with groups[] where each group carries group_id, submitted and scripts[]
Notes: tests/api/workflow/dvs-role-workflow.spec.ts step 9.4 reads groups[0].scripts[0].state

Title: A draft paper is not selectable
Preconditions: A draft paper exists in the same subject
Steps: 1) GET subject-papers; 2) Filter rows whose status is draft
Expected Result: No draft paper is returned
Notes: spec SCN-13; md SCN-13

Title: A centre whose papers are all draft returns an empty list
Steps: 1) GET subject-papers; 2) Read the papers array
Expected Result: 200 with papers = [] and no error
Notes: Confirm the UI shows an empty state rather than an error

Title: Listed paper settings equal the configured paper settings
Steps: 1) GET subject-papers; 2) Compare the row with the configured paper
Expected Result: scripts_per_packet and pages_per_script equal the configured 1 and 2
Notes: Workflow spec step 8.3 asserts pages_per_script

Title: The scanning catalog returns its documented sections
Steps: 1) GET /api/v1/scanning/catalog; 2) Read each documented key
Expected Result: 200 with papers, eligible_scripts, scanners, batches, jobs, rescan_batches and maintenance
Notes: Schema scanning_catalog documents these keys; confirm the scanner role may read the route

Title: A fresh centre returns empty batch and job arrays
Steps: 1) GET /api/v1/scanning/catalog; 2) Read batches and jobs
Expected Result: Both are empty arrays rather than null and no error is raised
Notes: Null versus empty-array behaviour to confirm

Title: The reports config exposes the five receiving report definitions
Steps: 1) GET /api/v1/receiving/guided/reports/config; 2) Read each report key, title, station and enabled flag
Expected Result: packet_preparation_report, bundle_preparation_report, custody_inward_report, packet_scan_qc_report and subject_digitization_report are present with key, title, station and enabled
Notes: Schema receiving_reports_config lists exactly these five keys

Title: Digitization offers the receiving reports that are enabled for the centre
Preconditions: SCN-039 passed and at least one report has enabled = true
Steps: 1) Open Digitize scripts; 2) Open the reports control
Expected Result: Each enabled report is offered with its title; the station is shown
Notes: No report UI route is documented; confirm where the controls render

Title: Catalog centre identity matches the centre scoping the paper list
Steps: 1) Read centre.id, code and name from the catalog; 2) Read the centre implied by the paper list
Expected Result: Both responses describe the same centre id, code and name
Notes: subject-papers also returns source_institutions; cross-check the centre identity

Title: QP code options match the papers returned by the API
Steps: 1) Open Digitize scripts; 2) Open the QP code control; 3) Compare its options with GET subject-papers
Expected Result: Each listed paper appears once as a QP code option and no extra code is offered
Notes: QP code label and the KAN001 example are captured in sections 15.1 and 21

Title: Creating a script returns its identity, group and packet size
Steps: 1) POST /api/v1/receiving/guided/subject-scripts with paper_id and a fresh idempotency_key; 2) Read script_id, group_id, packet_size and version
Expected Result: 200 with script_id, script_code, group_id, group_number, group_count, packet_size and version
Notes: spec SCN-20; workflow spec step 9.1 validates the schema

Title: packet_size equals scripts_per_packet
Steps: 1) Compare script.packet_size with paper.scripts_per_packet; 2) Confirm the two values are equal
Expected Result: The values are equal
Notes: Workflow spec step 9.1 asserts packet_size = scriptsPerPacket

Title: group_number and group_count are internally consistent
Steps: 1) Read group_number, group_count and packet_size; 2) Check group_number is within group_count
Expected Result: group_number is at most group_count and group_count is consistent with packet_size
Notes: Counter arithmetic for packets larger than one script is unverified because the reference data uses scripts_per_packet = 1

Title: A created script appears under its group before any capture
Steps: 1) GET subject-scripts?paper_id=<paper>; 2) Find the group by group_id and the script by script_id
Expected Result: Both are present and the script carries its pre-capture state
Notes: The initial state label is not documented; capture the exact value

Title: A duplicate idempotency_key does not create a second script
Steps: 1) Repeat POST subject-scripts with the same paper_id and idempotency_key; 2) Count scripts for the paper
Expected Result: Exactly one script exists and the replay returns the original script_id
Notes: md SCN-27 claims coverage but the current spec sends a fresh key each time

Title: Concurrent duplicate idempotency_key creates exactly one script
Preconditions: Two request contexts authenticated as the same Scanner
Steps: 1) Fire two POST subject-scripts calls in parallel with one idempotency_key; 2) Count the scripts of the paper
Expected Result: One script is created; the second call returns the same script_id or a 4xx
Notes: Requires a parallel request context to hit the race window

Title: Upload intents can be issued for every page 1..N of the script
Steps: 1) POST manual-scan/uploads for page_number 1 through pages_per_script; 2) Read each response id
Expected Result: Each page number receives its own intent id and asset_version
Notes: Happy-path loop that proves per-page intent issuance

Title: Creating a script for a draft paper is refused
Preconditions: A draft paper id in the same subject
Steps: 1) POST subject-scripts with the draft paper_id; 2) Read the response status and the script list
Expected Result: 4xx is returned and no script is created
Notes: Draft exclusion is asserted for reads (SCN-034); the write path needs the same guard

Title: A second script for the same paper is placed in the next group
Preconditions: scripts_per_packet is 1 and one script already exists
Steps: 1) POST subject-scripts for the same paper with a new idempotency_key; 2) Compare group_id and group_number with the first script
Expected Result: The second script has a different group_id and the next group_number
Notes: Group rollover with scripts_per_packet = 1 is the only configured case

Title: A create-script retry after a client timeout yields one script
Steps: 1) Start POST subject-scripts and drop the response; 2) Retry with the same idempotency_key
Expected Result: One script exists for the paper and the retry returns its identity
Notes: Needs a fault-injecting proxy to drop the first response

Title: An upload intent is issued per page with url, headers, version and expiry
Steps: 1) POST /api/v1/repository/manual-scan/uploads with script_id, page_number, content_type image/png and maximum_bytes; 2) Read id, upload_url, headers, version and expires_at
Expected Result: 200 with id, upload_url, expires_at, headers.Content-Type, version and asset_version
Notes: spec SCN-21; workflow spec step 9.2 validates the intent schema

Title: Uploading the page to the signed URL returns 201
Steps: 1) PUT the PNG bytes to upload_url with the intent headers; 2) Read the response status
Expected Result: The storage endpoint returns 201
Notes: spec SCN-22

Title: Intent headers carry the requested Content-Type
Steps: 1) Read intent.headers.Content-Type; 2) Compare it with the content_type sent
Expected Result: They are equal, image/png
Notes: The intent schema requires headers.Content-Type

Title: Intent expiry is set in the future
Steps: 1) Read expires_at; 2) Convert the value to a timestamp
Expected Result: expires_at is later than the current time
Notes: expires_at is an integer; the unit (seconds or milliseconds) must be confirmed

Title: Upload after the intent expiry is rejected
Steps: 1) Wait until expires_at has passed; 2) PUT the page bytes to upload_url
Expected Result: Storage refuses with 4xx and finalize cannot complete the page
Notes: Expiry window length is unknown; may need a short-lived override

Title: Finalize with a mismatched content type is rejected
Steps: 1) Request an intent for image/png; 2) Finalize declaring a different content type
Expected Result: 4xx is returned and the page is not stored
Notes: md SCN-28; the observed finalize body carries version, sha256 and byte_size, so confirm where the type is compared

Title: The first remaining page is accepted as page 1
Preconditions: SCN-053 passed and a page image after the cut cover
Steps: 1) Request an intent for page_number 1; 2) Upload and finalize that image
Expected Result: Page 1 is stored and counts toward the page total
Notes: Cut-cover handling is a documented procedure in section 15.2, not a server rule

Title: Remaining script pages are accepted in filename order
Steps: 1) Upload page_number 2 with the second image; 2) Finalize it
Expected Result: Page 2 is stored and the script total reaches two
Notes: Order preservation is asserted separately in SCN-087

Title: An unsupported image content type is rejected
Steps: 1) Request an intent with content_type image/tiff then application/pdf; 2) Read each response status and body
Expected Result: 4xx is returned and no intent is issued
Notes: Only image/png is observed; the supported type list must be confirmed

Title: A zero-byte image is rejected
Steps: 1) Request an intent with maximum_bytes 0; 2) PUT an empty body; 3) Finalize with byte_size 0
Expected Result: The flow is refused at intent, upload or finalize and no empty page is stored
Notes: Which of the three calls rejects it is unconfirmed

Title: An image of exactly maximum_bytes is accepted
Steps: 1) Request an intent whose maximum_bytes equals the file length; 2) Upload and finalize
Expected Result: Upload and finalize succeed, so the boundary is inclusive
Notes: Inclusive versus exclusive boundary to confirm

Title: An oversized image is refused as a storage-abuse guard
Steps: 1) Request an intent with maximum_bytes smaller than the file; 2) PUT the larger file
Expected Result: Request is refused and no oversized page is stored
Notes: Enforcement may sit in the storage policy rather than the API

Title: A corrupt PNG with the declared length is rejected
Steps: 1) PUT truncated PNG bytes with the correct byte length; 2) Finalize with the matching sha256
Expected Result: The page is not completed; a 4xx or a non-completed status is returned
Notes: Whether image validity is checked server-side is unconfirmed

Title: page_number 0 is rejected
Steps: 1) Request an intent with page_number 0; 2) Read the response status and body
Expected Result: 4xx is returned and no page is created
Notes: Page numbering must be 1-based; confirm the error surface

Title: page_number above pages_per_script is rejected
Steps: 1) Request an intent with page_number = pages_per_script + 1; 2) Read the response status and body
Expected Result: 4xx is returned and no extra page is created
Notes: Server-side limit versus UI-only limit to confirm

Title: Each page intent carries its own asset_version
Steps: 1) Compare asset_version across the intents of page 1 and page 2; 2) Confirm each intent reports its own value
Expected Result: Each intent reports an asset_version and the value advances per page
Notes: asset_version is a documented field; the increment rule is unconfirmed

Title: Finalize stores the checksum and completes the page
Steps: 1) POST /api/v1/repository/uploads/{uploadId}/finalize with version, sha256 and byte_size; 2) Read status, sha256 and byte_size
Expected Result: 200 with status completed, the submitted sha256 and byte_size
Notes: spec SCN-23; workflow spec step 9.2 asserts status and sha256

Title: The stored sha256 equals the client-computed hash
Steps: 1) Recompute sha256 of the uploaded bytes; 2) Compare it with the finalize response
Expected Result: The values are identical
Notes: Workflow spec asserts finalized.sha256

Title: The stored byte_size equals the uploaded length
Steps: 1) Compare byte_size with the file length; 2) Confirm the two values are equal
Expected Result: byte_size in the finalize response equals the uploaded file length exactly
Notes: The finalize response carries byte_size

Title: A checksum mismatch is rejected and the page is not completed
Steps: 1) Finalize with the sha256 of different bytes; 2) Read the response status and the upload record
Expected Result: 4xx is returned and the page is not completed
Notes: Core integrity claim; exact status and error code to confirm

Title: Finalize with a wrong byte_size is rejected
Steps: 1) Finalize with byte_size off by one; 2) Read the response status and the upload record
Expected Result: A 4xx is returned and the upload record keeps its original byte_size
Notes: Confirms byte_size is compared with the stored object

Title: A partial upload cannot be finalized
Preconditions: SCN-053 passed and the object was never uploaded
Steps: 1) Request an intent; 2) Finalize without the PUT
Expected Result: A 4xx is returned and no completed page appears for that page number
Notes: Prevents empty placeholder pages in the packet

Title: A malformed sha256 is rejected
Steps: 1) Finalize with a 12-character hex string; 2) Read the response status and the upload record
Expected Result: A 4xx is returned and the malformed hash is not stored
Notes: Length and encoding validation to confirm

Title: An upper-case hex sha256 is accepted or normalized
Steps: 1) Finalize with the hash in upper case; 2) Read the response
Expected Result: Either accepted and normalized to lower case, or rejected with a clear 4xx
Notes: Case handling is unconfirmed

Title: A finalize retry after a timeout is idempotent
Steps: 1) Send finalize and drop the response; 2) Resend the same body
Expected Result: One completed page; the second call returns the same id, sha256 and byte_size
Notes: Confirms the version field makes the replay safe

Title: The stored checksum and size are not editable after completion
Steps: 1) POST finalize again for the completed upload with a different sha256; 2) Re-read the upload record
Expected Result: The completed record is unchanged or the request is refused
Notes: Confirms checksums behave as append-only evidence

Title: Complete-scan records the page count and returns state scanned
Steps: 1) POST /api/v1/repository/scripts/{scriptId}/complete-scan with version and page_count; 2) Read state and processing_run_id
Expected Result: 200 with script_id, script_code, version, state scanned and processing_run_id
Notes: spec SCN-25; workflow spec step 9.3

Title: The captured page count equals pages_per_script
Steps: 1) Compare the recorded page count with paper.pages_per_script; 2) Confirm the two values are equal
Expected Result: The page count recorded at complete-scan equals pages_per_script, 2
Notes: spec SCN-24

Title: Complete-scan with fewer pages than configured is refused
Steps: 1) POST complete-scan with page_count 1; 2) Read the response status and re-read the script state
Expected Result: 4xx is returned and the script state is unchanged
Notes: md SCN-29; confirm the state stays unscanned

Title: Complete-scan with more pages than configured is refused
Steps: 1) POST complete-scan with page_count = pages_per_script + 1; 2) Read the response status and re-read the script state
Expected Result: A 4xx is returned and the script remains in its pre-complete state
Notes: The upper bound of the gate is unconfirmed

Title: Complete-scan with page_count 0 is refused
Steps: 1) POST complete-scan with page_count 0; 2) Read the response status and re-read the script state
Expected Result: A 4xx is returned and no zero-page script passes the gate
Notes: Zero must not pass the gate

Title: Complete-scan with a stale version is refused
Steps: 1) Re-send complete-scan with version - 1; 2) Read the response status and re-read the script state
Expected Result: 4xx (expected 409) is returned and the script is not re-scanned
Notes: Optimistic concurrency is exposed through version and asset_version; exact code to confirm

Title: The scanned script appears in the paper script list as scanned
Steps: 1) GET subject-scripts?paper_id=<paper>; 2) Read the entry for script_id
Expected Result: The entry is present and its state reads scanned before processing finishes
Notes: Distinguishes the scanned state from stored (SCN-091)

Title: Stored page numbers are contiguous 1..N
Steps: 1) Read expected_pages and scanned_pages from /api/v1/scanning/catalog jobs; 2) Compare the two counters
Expected Result: scanned_pages equals expected_pages and no page number is missing
Notes: No per-page read route is documented; scanning catalog jobs is the closest observed surface

Title: Page order is preserved with the cut cover excluded
Preconditions: A physical script with a cut cover plus a two-page script
Steps: 1) Capture the page after the cut cover first; 2) Capture the remaining page; 3) Read the stored page order
Expected Result: Page 1 is the first page after the cut cover and page 2 follows; the cut cover is absent
Notes: Order is a procedure in section 15.2; needs visual inspection of the stored images

Title: A capture that includes the cut cover fails the page-count gate
Preconditions: A capture that includes the cut cover as an extra page
Steps: 1) Finalize pages 1 to 3 for a two-page script; 2) POST complete-scan with page_count 3
Expected Result: Request is refused and the operator must drop the cut cover and resubmit the script
Notes: Repeats SCN-082 with the real cut-cover scenario

Title: Submit script with the required pages enters processing
Preconditions: A two-page script selected in Digitize scripts
Steps: 1) Choose the QP code; 2) Keep Capture method Upload; 3) Choose the first remaining page and the remaining pages; 4) Click Submit script
Expected Result: The script shows its identity, page count and a processing state
Test Data: QP code KAN001 and two page images
Notes: Section 15.2; no Digitization page object exists yet

Title: Submit script is unavailable until the page count matches
Preconditions: Digitize scripts open with one of two pages chosen
Steps: 1) Select a single page; 2) Inspect the Submit script control
Expected Result: Submit script is disabled or blocked and the explanation names the missing page count
Notes: Client-side gate wording to confirm

Title: Processing stores the script
Steps: 1) Poll GET subject-scripts?paper_id=<paper> every 2s until the state settles; 2) Record the first state that settles
Expected Result: The state reaches stored
Notes: spec SCN-26; workflow spec step 9.4

Title: stored is reached inside the documented polling budget
Steps: 1) Time the interval between complete-scan and the stored state; 2) Compare the elapsed time with the budget
Expected Result: stored inside the polling budget used by the suites: 90s in tests/api/workflow/dvs-role-workflow.spec.ts and 120s in tests/web/workflow/complete-workflow.spec.ts
Notes: md SCN-40

Title: The processing state and blocked submit are announced to assistive technology
Steps: 1) Start a screen-reader or accessibility snapshot; 2) Read the script row while processing; 3) Read the blocked Submit script control
Expected Result: The processing state and the blocked-submit reason are exposed as text or a live region, not only as a colour change
Notes: Requires an accessibility snapshot; mark environment-blocked if no screen reader is available

Title: A storage delay is explained with an actionable retry message
Preconditions: A processing run that exceeds the polling budget
Steps: 1) Poll beyond the budget; 2) Read the operator-facing message
Expected Result: A timeout or retry message is shown, the packet is not marked ready, and the processing_run_id is available for support
Notes: No timeout copy is documented in section 15; capture the actual message

Title: The operator sees the processing state for the script
Steps: 1) Open Review packets or the script row while processing; 2) Read the state label and page count on the row
Expected Result: The script row shows a processing state together with its page count
Notes: Label wording for each state is not documented

Title: Catalog reads stay inside the agreed latency budget
Steps: 1) Time GET /api/v1/receiving/guided/catalog and subject-papers; 2) Compare the elapsed times with the agreed budget
Expected Result: Both respond inside the agreed budget and the digitization UI renders without a spinner stall
Notes: Capture a baseline first; no threshold is documented in the repository

Title: After a dropped connection the operator is cued to the same script
Steps: 1) Drop the connection during polling; 2) Reload the workspace; 3) Read the script row and any connection message
Expected Result: The operator is shown a reconnect or retry cue and the same script, never a second script row
Notes: State must not double-create on refresh; confirm the cue copy

Title: Session expiry mid-capture resumes the same script after re-auth
Steps: 1) Let the session expire; 2) Sign in again; 3) Reopen the script
Expected Result: The script with the same script_id and group_id is resumed and no duplicate script exists
Notes: Session timeout is configured by the Access governance policy

Title: State advances from scanned to stored without regression
Steps: 1) Poll every 2s and record each observed state; 2) Compare the ordered sequence of states
Expected Result: The observed states form the sequence scanned then stored and never move backwards
Notes: Long-run sampling needed to confirm there is no flicker

Title: Repeated catalog reads are consistent
Steps: 1) GET the receiving catalog three times; 2) Compare centre and paper ids across the three responses
Expected Result: All three responses return the same centre and the same paper set
Notes: md SCN-41

Title: A centre without a scanner still completes a script by upload
Preconditions: No scanner device confirmed for the centre
Steps: 1) Keep Capture method Upload; 2) Capture and submit a script
Expected Result: The script reaches stored and its packet can be submitted
Notes: Section 15.3 forbids faking a scanner result

Title: The Scanner method reports Scanner: Not verified without a device
Preconditions: Capture method Scanner selected and no confirmed device
Steps: 1) Switch Capture method to Scanner; 2) Read the scanner status line
Expected Result: The status line reports Scanner: Not verified and no scan is started
Notes: Copy captured in section 15.3

Title: Switching capture method keeps already-uploaded pages
Preconditions: One page already uploaded for the script
Steps: 1) Switch Capture method from Upload to Scanner; 2) Read the page list
Expected Result: The uploaded page is still listed and the page count is unchanged
Notes: Prevents silent data loss when the scanner fails mid-script

Title: A stored page cannot be silently overwritten by a repeat capture
Preconditions: A script with page 1 already stored
Steps: 1) Re-run capture for page 1; 2) Read the stored page count and the page identity
Expected Result: The stored page is either superseded at a new version or blocked; the page count never exceeds the configured pages
Notes: Confirms stored evidence is versioned and tamper-visible

Title: Two operators scan different scripts of one paper concurrently
Preconditions: Two Scanner sessions on the same centre
Steps: 1) Create two scripts for the paper; 2) Capture both in parallel; 3) Submit each group
Expected Result: Both scripts reach stored and each group closes independently
Notes: Confirms group counters are not shared across operators

Title: Two concurrent intents for one page keep one stored page
Steps: 1) Request two intents for page_number 1 in parallel; 2) Upload and finalize both; 3) Read the page count
Expected Result: The script still expects the configured page count and one page is authoritative
Notes: version and asset_version must arbitrate the winner

Title: Concurrent double submit produces one submission
Steps: 1) POST submit twice in parallel; 2) Read both response statuses and the group state
Expected Result: One 200 and one 400 or 409; closed and submitted are true once
Notes: Sequential double submit is covered by SCN-114

Title: Concurrent catalog reads during capture stay consistent
Steps: 1) Read the catalog from two contexts while a script is being captured; 2) Compare centre and paper ids across the two responses
Expected Result: Both responses agree on the centre and the paper set
Notes: Guards against per-request centre resolution differences

Title: Review packets shows the packet identity and its stored scripts
Preconditions: All scripts of the packet stored
Steps: 1) Open Review packets; 2) Read the packet row and its scripts
Expected Result: The group number, group count and each stored script appear
Notes: Section 15.4; packet counters are absent from the subject-scripts response, so read them from the review surface

Title: A complete packet submits and closes
Steps: 1) POST /api/v1/receiving/guided/subject-groups/{groupId}/submit; 2) Read submitted and closed
Expected Result: 200 with submitted = true and closed = true
Notes: spec SCN-30; workflow spec step 9.5

Title: The submit response matches its documented schema
Steps: 1) Validate the response against receiving_subject_group_submit; 2) Read the validation result
Expected Result: group_id, group_number, group_count, closed and submitted are all present with the right types
Notes: spec SCN-34 and the workflow spec both validate the schema

Title: The submitted packet is allocation-ready for the Chief
Steps: 1) Sign in as the Chief; 2) GET the subject groups of the examiner batch; 3) Find the group
Expected Result: The group shows ready = true, submitted = true and stored_count = total_count
Notes: md SCN-31; workflow spec step 10.1

Title: An incomplete packet cannot be submitted
Preconditions: A group with a script that never reached stored
Steps: 1) POST submit for that group; 2) Read the response status and the group state
Expected Result: 4xx is returned and the packet stays open
Notes: md SCN-32

Title: A double submit is refused
Steps: 1) POST submit again for the same group; 2) Read the response status and the group state
Expected Result: 400 or 409 is returned and only one submission exists
Notes: spec SCN-33 accepts 400 or 409

Title: The submit response echoes the group number and count of the packet
Steps: 1) Compare group_number and group_count in the submit response with the create-script response; 2) Confirm the two value pairs match
Expected Result: The values match the group that was created
Notes: Confirms the closure response describes the same packet

Title: A closed packet stays closed after a repeat submit
Steps: 1) POST submit a third time; 2) Read the group state
Expected Result: closed and submitted remain true and no version regression occurs
Notes: Closure must be one-way

Title: A new script cannot be added to a closed packet
Steps: 1) Create a script for the same paper after the group closed; 2) Re-read the closed group
Expected Result: The closed group keeps its original script set
Notes: Attach path is unconfirmed; assert the closed group script list is unchanged

Title: The Scanner cannot un-submit or re-open a packet
Steps: 1) Look for an un-submit or re-open action in Digitization; 2) Probe any reverse route that exists
Expected Result: No reverse action is available and any probe returns 403 or 404
Notes: No un-submit route is documented in api/endpoints/routes.ts; record the probe result

Title: Approved rescans lists only approved rescan batches for the centre
Preconditions: An approved rescan batch exists for the centre
Steps: 1) Open the Approved rescans tab; 2) Read the list
Expected Result: Only approved rescan batches of this centre are listed
Notes: rescan_batches appears in the scanning catalog schema; the approving role is undocumented

Title: A submission is attributable to the operator in an audit record
Steps: 1) Submit a packet; 2) Read the audit or history surface for the script and its group
Expected Result: An entry records the operator, the script, the group and a timestamp
Notes: No audit endpoint is documented in api/endpoints/routes.ts; identify the surface before asserting

Title: Script row records the configured page count and stored state
Steps: 1) Query the script row by id; 2) Compare page_count and state.
Expected Result: page_count equals the paper setting and state is stored; one row per idempotency key.
Notes: Read-only query; idempotency replay must not add a row.

Title: Page rows keep checksum, size and content type
Steps: 1) Query pages for the script ordered by page_number; 2) Verify sha256, byte_size and content_type.
Expected Result: Every page exists once with the uploaded checksum and size; page order is contiguous 1..N.
Notes: No page may be duplicated or missing.

Title: Packet counters match the script states
Steps: 1) Query the group and its scripts; 2) Compare submitted/closed counters.
Expected Result: Group is closed with stored count equal to total; every script state matches the packet counter.
Notes: Incomplete packets must not set closed.

Title: Centre scope prevents foreign paper rows
Steps: 1) Query scripts and pages visible to this centre; 2) Attempt a foreign paper id through the API.
Expected Result: Only the assigned centre's rows are returned; the foreign create is refused and adds no row.
Test Data: Assigned centre id and foreign paper id
Notes: Read-only DB plus one API attempt.

Title: 100 concurrent page uploads lose no page
Steps: 1) Upload all pages in parallel; 2) Finalize and compare page rows and checksums.
Expected Result: All 100 pages are stored exactly once with correct checksums; no partial or duplicate page.
Notes: Record the measured p95 and confirm the agreed budget in Notes before gating CI.

Title: Two-hundred-page script finalizes within budget
Preconditions: A paper configured for 200 pages per script.
Steps: 1) Upload and finalize 200 pages; 2) Poll until stored and measure elapsed time.
Expected Result: State reaches stored within the agreed budget; page_count is 200; no timeout or orphan page.
Notes: Record the measured p95 and confirm the agreed budget in Notes before gating CI.

Title: Ten times packet volume preserves closure and readiness
Steps: 1) Process all packets; 2) Query closure and allocation readiness.
Expected Result: Counts are exact; every complete packet is closed and allocation-ready; no open packet is marked ready.
Notes: Record the measured p95 and confirm the agreed budget in Notes before gating CI.
